subject: Arborlane vendor activation — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO routing
messages:
From: Nadia Perez <nadia@arborlane.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@arborlane.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Arborlane vendor activation — initial packet and questions

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting the vendor activation to get Redwood live for our support automation pilot. Procurement asked me to collect the following from your side before they issue the PO:

- Executed DPA (DocuSign preferred)
- SOC 2 Type II report or read-only link to the report
- Current subprocessor list (including cloud infra providers)
- Invoicing instructions and PO contact; we need net30 by default but can confirm once your billing team responds

Attaching our initial SOW and an invoice template for your reference. A couple of questions up front:
1) Is AWS (us-east-1) listed as a subprocessor that stores customer data?
2) Do you accept PO + invoice via AP portal (invoices@arborlane.com) or do you require billing@redwood.com?

If we can get the DPA and SOC2 link today, procurement will try to get a PO out by Tuesday.

Thanks — Nadia

--
Nadia Perez
Vendor Ops, Arborlane Inc.
procurement@arborlane.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Arborlane_SOW_v1.pdf, PO_Template.xlsx

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Perez <nadia@arborlane.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Arborlane vendor activation — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO routing

Hi Nadia — great to hear from you. Welcome, and excited to get Arborlane set up. Action items below and links/attachments at the bottom.

Quick answers:
- Yes, we use AWS (us-east-1) and it is listed in our subprocessor list.
- We accept invoices at invoices@redwood.com and can reconcile against an Arborlane PO. Standard terms are net30 unless a different term is negotiated with finance.

What I'm sending now:
1) Editable DPA (we prefer DocuSign for signatures) — link: https://redwood-drive.example.com/shared/Arborlane-DPA-2026
2) SOC 2 Type II read-only link: https://redwood-security.example.com/soc2-report-2026.pdf
3) Current subprocessor list (see section 4 of the DPA and the attached PDF copy)
4) PO routing and invoicing checklist (attached PO_Instructions.pdf)

Next steps for Arborlane:
- Please review and sign the DPA (DocuSign link below) or send redlines to legal@redwood.com.
- Upload signed W9 (if US entity) to the vendor portal: https://vendor-portal.arborlane.com/activation/12345
- Confirm billing contact and PO number so we can map the invoice on receipt.

DocuSign envelope (prepped): https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC123456

I've looped in Irene (legal) for any DPA redlines and Ben (finance ops) for PO/invoice details. For any urgent billing exceptions (e.g., net45), please flag and Ben will advise.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Partner Success Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0123

Attachments: PO_Instructions.pdf

Thanks Sofia — that's super helpful. A couple of follow-ups from procurement:

- We attached a signed W9 to this reply (signed_W9.pdf).
- Arborlane's finance prefers invoices sent to invoices@arborlane.com; PO will be generated from our portal (we'll share the PO number once issued).

We reviewed the DPA link — we'll sign via DocuSign unless your legal asks for redlines. Target: get DPA signed by EOD Monday.

Best,
Nadia

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 06 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Arborlane vendor activation — DPA redline guidance

Sofia / Ben — quick legal note after scanning Arborlane's ask:

- CloudCache Inc.: confirmed — CloudCache handles anonymized telemetry and caching layer only, no customer PII. I'll add a one-line statement to the subprocessor appendix to make that explicit.

- DPA redlines: I reviewed the DPA link. Arborlane's standard edits look reasonable except for two items we should push back on:
  1) Data deletion timeline: they request 15 days after termination; we should counter to our standard 30 days given sync windows.
  2) Indemnity carve-outs: they attempted to remove the service-provider carve-out; we should retain our existing language.

Action items:
- I'll prepare a redline (redlined_DPA.pdf) and upload to the shared drive. If Arborlane signs as-is via DocuSign before we submit redlines, we can still ask for a side-letter clarifying the two points, but I'd prefer we get the redline in advance.
- Ben: confirm whether we can accept 'invoices@arborlane.com' for AP mapping (should be fine) and confirm PO matching rules (PO number required on invoice).

Sofia — please reply to Nadia and let them know we will upload a redline by COB Monday, but we are happy to accept DocuSign if they need the PO sooner (we'll then follow up with the side-letter).

Thanks — Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
